question: What Are the 7 Types of Pressure Relief Valves?
body_html:
Pressure relief valves come in seven common types, each using a different closing force, so the valve opens when system pressure exceeds a preset value and reseats once pressure is normal.

TypeTypical Use
Spring loadedBoilers, compressors, pumps
Pilot operatedHigh pressure gas pipelines
Temperature activatedBlocked in liquid lines
Balanced bellowsClosed discharge, variable back pressure
Nozzle typeHigh pressure steam
Piston and diaphragmHydraulics, corrosive low pressure service
